note: P4358 (Pro 29:26) — many seek a ruler's face, but justice for a man comes from the LORD.

dims.v: misplaced hope — courting human power for justice
the seeking of a ruler's face by the many — the courting of human power and patronage for a favourable outcome, hope placed in men where true justice comes only from the LORD
set against the justice that comes from the LORD
baqash (seek) — 'many SEEK the face of a ruler'; men crowd to court human power for a favourable verdict. But patronage is a fickle hope — the ruler's favour is not where justice truly rests.
true source — the justice a man ultimately receives from God
the justice that a man gets from the LORD — the recognition that final, true justice comes not from courting rulers but from God, the real dispenser of every man's due
the courting of rulers it corrects (266870)
set against the seeking of human favour

mishpat (justice) — 'but it is from the LORD that a man gets JUSTICE'; behind all human courts stands God, the true source of every man's justice. Trust the LORD, not the ruler's whim, for a right outcome (cf 21:1; 16:33).
